items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Oh, Sonny was the personality kid of the band.

ctx.x: -- when you joined the band in 1932, the drummer was Sonny Greer and (he) remained the drummer all the time until you left in 1951. Tell me a little bit about Sonny Greer?

Oh, Sonny was the personality kid of the band. He was drummer, as you know and was flash -- was flashy. Everything he did was flashy. He had the most beautiful, one of the most beautiful sets of drums in the business when I joined in 1932. And he took great pride in polishing them and keeping them. He had a complete set including timpanies and vibraphones and all kinds of drums and cymbals and chimes, everything. And he really dressed up the band. With his outfit.
They used to seat him -- like the top of a pyramid.

items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: And Lawrence Brown, take a trombone and play clarinet parts. He done it in our band.

ctx.x: And Lawrence Brown, take a trombone and play clarinet parts. He done it in our band.
Yeah, I know, you told me that.
